description: Read a structured electronic invoice as an invoice and check it. Handles European EN 16931 invoices in UBL (Invoice, CreditNote) and UN/CEFACT CII syntax — the formats XRechnung, Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, Factur-X and ZUGFeRD carry — and Indian GST e-invoices (the invoice JSON sent to the Invoice Registration Portal, and the signed QR code token printed on the invoice). Returns the format and profile, seller, buyer, lines, tax breakdown and totals, and findings that name the rule broken: required business terms, line and total arithmetic, VAT breakdown, code lists, and Peppol, XRechnung and Indian portal rules. A viewer with checks, not a conformance validator: it does not run the official Schematron rules. Pass XML or JSON text; for a Factur-X PDF, pass the embedded XML.

invoice.description: The invoice as text: UBL or CII XML, Indian invoice JSON, or an Indian signed QR token.

public_key.description: Optional public key (PEM or base64) to verify an Indian signed token. Without it the token is decoded, not verified.

name: einvoice_read
title: Read a structured e-invoice
